---
title: "Main water system"
---

The model of the main water system holds the rivers, canals and lakes of Rijkswaterstaat.
The scripts are in [`pipeline/rijkswaterstaat`](https://github.com/Deltares/Ribasim-NL/tree/main/pipeline/rijkswaterstaat), numbered in order of execution, and run in three DVC stages.

![The model of the main water system on the map.](https://s3.deltares.nl/ribasim-nl/doc-image/figures/main-water-system.png){width=70% fig-alt="Map of the Netherlands with the Basin areas of the IJsselmeer, the rivers, the delta and the canals in blue, links between them, and small markers for the structures and boundaries."}

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
  subgraph frozen["bathymetry, frozen"]
    s1["1_bathymetrie.py<br>verwerkt/bathymetrie"]
  end
  subgraph demand["hws_demand"]
    direction TB
    s2["2_basins.py<br>Basins and profiles"] --> s3["3_netwerk.py<br>verwerkt/netwerk.gpkg"]
    s3 --> s4["4_kunstwerken.py<br>verwerkt/hydamo.gpkg"]
    s4 --> s5["5_model_netwerk.py<br>modellen/hws_netwerk"]
    s5 --> s6["6_model_sturing.py<br>modellen/hws_sturing"]
    s6 --> s7["7_model_onttrekkingen.py<br>modellen/hws_demand"]
    s7 --> s8a["8a_update_state.py<br>modellen/hws_demand"]
  end
  subgraph transient["hws_transient"]
    s8b["8b_update_bc.py<br>modellen/hws_transient"]
  end
  frozen --> demand --> transient --> merge["samenvoegen"]
  rwzi["rwzi"] --> transient
```

## Bathymetry

`1_bathymetrie.py` merges data from Baseline (version j23_6-v1, non-public) with grids from [bathymetrie-Nederland](https://maps.rijkswaterstaat.nl/geoweb55/index.html?viewer=Bathymetrie_Nederland) into one 5 × 5 m GeoTIFF.
Both are needed, since the Midden Limburgse en Noord Brabantse kanalen are not in Baseline, and the IJsselmeer is not completely covered in bathymetrie-Nederland.
For the mask we use Top10NL waterdelen and manually filled a boolean column `baseline`.

This stage is frozen, so it is not run again in a reproduction, since the source data does not change.

::: {layout-ncol=2}
![Bathymetry mask](https://s3.deltares.nl/ribasim-nl/doc-image/bathymetrie_mask.png)

![Bathymetry](https://s3.deltares.nl/ribasim-nl/doc-image/bathymetrie_result.png)
:::

## From data to a network

- `2_basins.py` derives the Basin areas of the main water system. From the bathymetry it writes a CSV file with the profile of each Basin, `verwerkt/basins_level_area.csv`.
- `3_netwerk.py` derives a `ribasim_nl.Network` (not a Ribasim network yet!) from OpenStreetMap, with modifications mainly in the IJsselmeer, to build the model network with in `5_model_netwerk.py`. It needs the Basins of `2_basins.py`, since a network node goes at each intersection of a Basin area with the network. This network, `verwerkt/netwerk.gpkg`, also guides the links in the [coupling](couple.qmd).
- `4_kunstwerken.py` combines the structures from NIS (Netwerk Informatie Systeem) of Rijkswaterstaat, Baseline, OpenStreetMap, the structures in the primary flood defences, and the abstractions, into a HyDAMO-based format, from which the Ribasim network is derived.
- `5_model_netwerk.py` combines the results of steps 2 to 4 into a first Ribasim model, `modellen/hws_netwerk/hws.toml`. It includes the distribution keys (verdeelsleutels) of Lobith and Monsin as structures, but no control nodes, and no demands.

## Control and demands

- `6_model_sturing.py` adds control, with ContinuousControl, DiscreteControl and FlowDemand nodes, into `modellen/hws_sturing/hws.toml`.
- `7_model_onttrekkingen.py` adds the demands of drinking water, industry and energy as UserDemands, splits Basins along a route where needed, and adds Junctions, into `modellen/hws_demand/hws.toml`.
- `8a_update_state.py` runs this model, and writes its final state back as its initial state.

## Boundaries and forcing

`8b_update_bc.py` makes the model that goes into the coupling, `modellen/hws_transient`, for 2017 up to 2020:

| What | Source |
|:-----|:-------|
| Discharges of the Rhine at Lobith and the Meuse at Monsin | Daily means, `aangeleverd/Matroos_debieten_2017_2022_Lobith_Monsin.xlsx` |
| Levels at Kornwerderzand and Den Oever | A seasonal table of −0.4 to −0.1 m, repeated every year |
| Level at IJmuiden | Constant −0.4 m |
| Precipitation and evaporation | LHM, as in the [forcing](forcing.qmd) of the regional models |
| Wastewater | The [RWZI model](forcing.qmd#sec-rwzi) |
| Measurements | Observation nodes, see `ribasim_nl.observations` |

The other model in this folder that is tracked, `hws_2025_10_1`, is a fixed earlier version, from which the fix script of Vechtstromen reads the polygon of the Twentekanaal.
